Subject: Welcome to Redwood — choose a 20-minute API setup slot

Hi Alex —

Thanks for signing up and welcome to Redwood. I’m Grace on the Developer Success team. We usually start with a short 20-minute sync to: 
- Confirm your evaluation goals (throughput, latency targets)
- Walk through a minimal integration (API key, example request)
- Answer quick infra questions so you can get representative metrics fast

Pick a time that works for you: https://cal.redwood.ai/quickstart/grace-20min (slots in PDT mornings and early afternoons). If none of those work, reply with two windows and I’ll coordinate.

If you prefer an SDR-led handoff for procurement or broader account setup, Ben (cc’d) will jump in. Otherwise, this call is purely technical and engineer-friendly.

Agenda (20 min):
- 0–5 min: goals & scope
- 5–12 min: quick API demo & example call
- 12–18 min: running a sample load + measurement tips
- 18–20 min: next steps (demo env, Dedicated options if you want committed capacity)

Attachments: redwood-quickstart-guide.pdf (1-page checklist)

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Grace O’Connor
Developer Success, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
https://redwood.ai
